ITA-5.58.15 śoṇitārbudaḥ शोणितार्बुदः
Boils with blackreddish blisters on the penis
A disorder characterized by blackish blisters; boil associated with blood; severe pain at the lesion site.

ITA-9.6.142 śoṇitāsthāpanakarma शोणितास्थापनकर्म
Haemostatic measure
Therapeutic measures adopted to achieve haemostasis.
